en: The place or point where something begins; or a person's family background.
ex: Scientists study the origin of the universe.
科學家研究宇宙的起源。

en: The outer or top part of something; or the flat top of a table; or to come up to the top of water.
ex: The surface of the lake was calm and smooth.
湖面平靜光滑。

en: The act of finding something for the first time; or something that is found.
ex: The discovery of penicillin saved millions of lives.
盤尼西林的發現拯救了數百萬人的性命。

en: Easily upset or hurt; or aware of other people's feelings; or reacting quickly to small changes.
ex: She is very sensitive to criticism.
她對批評非常敏感。

en: To decide something finally; or to make a home in a new place; or to end a disagreement; or to sink to the bottom.
ex: After many years of travel, he decided to settle down.
旅行多年後，他決定安定下來。

en: To say that someone has done something well; or words that show admiration.
ex: The teacher praised the students for their hard work.
老師稱讚學生們的努力。

en: A strong feeling of surprise; or a sudden, violent movement; or to give someone a bad surprise.
ex: The news of the accident was a shock to everyone.
事故的消息讓每個人都感到震驚。

en: A feeling of not being sure about something; or to think that something is probably not true.
ex: I doubt that he will arrive on time.
我懷疑他會準時到。

en: The process of adding numbers; or something added to something else.
ex: In addition to English, she speaks French and Spanish.
除了英語，她還會說法語和西班牙語。

en: A pain in your stomach.
ex: I ate too much ice cream and got a stomachache.
我吃太多冰淇淋，肚子痛了。

en: A hard, shiny material such as iron, gold or copper that is found in the earth and can conduct electricity.
ex: Gold and silver are precious metals.
金和銀是貴重金屬。

en: Words that you say to someone to show you are happy about their success or good luck.
ex: Congratulations on winning the competition!
恭喜你贏得比賽！

en: Money that people and companies must pay to the government; or to make someone feel tired or stressed.
ex: We pay tax on the money we earn.
我們要為賺到的錢繳稅。

en: A unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter.
ex: The pencil is fifteen centimeters long.
這支鉛筆長十五公分。

en: Completely; or in total; or considering everything.
ex: The shop has ten workers altogether.
這家店總共有十名員工。

en: The quality of being valuable or necessary; or the fact that something matters a lot.
ex: Teachers explain the importance of good health to children.
老師向孩子們說明健康的重要性。

en: Having a flat, even surface with no lumps; or without problems; or to make something flat.
ex: The road is smooth and easy to drive on.
這條路平坦，容易駕駛。

en: The air, water and land in which people, animals and plants live; or the conditions around you.
ex: We should all help protect the environment.
我們都應該幫忙保護環境。

en: To disagree with someone in words; or to give reasons for or against something.
ex: The two brothers argued about who would use the computer.
兩兄弟為誰要用電腦而吵了起來。

en: A type of product made by a particular company; or the name or mark that shows who made something.
ex: This is a famous brand of sports shoes.
這是一個知名的運動鞋品牌。

en: A level of quality or achievement; or something used as a model; or normal and usual.
ex: The school has very high standards of teaching.
這所學校的教學水準非常高。

en: A small, flat piece of metal used as money; or to invent a new word.
ex: He tossed a coin to decide who would go first.
他擲硬幣決定誰先走。

en: A book with empty pages in which you write notes; or a small, light computer.
ex: She wrote down the phone number in her notebook.
她把電話號碼寫在筆記本上。

en: The inside top surface of a room.
ex: There is a big fan hanging from the ceiling.
天花板上掛著一個大電扇。

en: Of this or that kind; or so great; or used to emphasize something.
ex: It was such a nice day that we went to the park.
天氣好極了，所以我們去了公園。

en: To finish making or doing something; or having all the parts; or total.
ex: Please complete this form and hand it in.
請填寫完這張表格並交上來。

en: An area of land around a building; or a unit of length equal to about 91 centimeters.
ex: The children are playing in the yard.
孩子們在院子裡玩耍。

en: A hard, black substance that is dug from the ground and burned as fuel.
ex: In the past, people used coal to heat their homes.
過去人們用煤來取暖。

en: To hit something repeatedly; or to defeat someone in a game; or a regular rhythm; or the sound of a heart.
ex: Our team beat theirs by two goals.
我們隊以兩球之差擊敗了他們。

en: A large group of soldiers organized to fight on land.
ex: He joined the army when he was eighteen.
他十八歲時入伍從軍。

en: The group of people who control a country or state; or the system of controlling a country.
ex: The government announced a new plan to build schools.
政府宣布了一項興建學校的新計畫。

en: A person whose job is to sell goods in a store.
ex: The salesperson showed us several kinds of shoes.
售貨員給我們看了好幾種鞋子。

en: Something that happens, especially something important; or a race or competition in sports.
ex: The school sports day is an important annual event.
學校運動會是重要的年度活動。

en: A combination of different things; or something made by mixing different substances.
ex: Her feelings were a mixture of joy and fear.
她的心情夾雜著喜悅與恐懼。

en: To cause a change in someone or something; or to make someone feel sad or happy.
ex: Lack of sleep affects your health.
睡眠不足會影響你的健康。

en: To ask for something in a humble way, especially food or money; or to ask someone urgently to do something.
ex: The little dog begged for food at the table.
小狗在餐桌旁討食物吃。

en: Belonging to one person; not for everyone; or secret; or a soldier of the lowest rank.
ex: This is a private party for family members only.
這是一場只限家人參加的私人派對。

en: A man admired for brave acts; or the main male character in a story; (heroine) the female form.
ex: The fireman became a hero after saving the child.
那位消防員在救出孩子後成了英雄。

en: The special purpose or job of something; or an important social event; or to work in the proper way.
ex: The function of the heart is to pump blood.
心臟的功能是輸送血液。

en: A person you do not know; or a person who is new to a place.
ex: Never open the door to a stranger.
絕不要對陌生人開門。
